rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for extreme physical or emotional pain and distress.

example.english: Seeing my mother suffer causes me anguish.
example.traditional: 見到媽媽病得咁辛苦，我個心真係好痛苦。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 maa1 maa1 beng6 dak1 gam3 san1 fu2 ngo5 go3 sam1 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung3 fu2

rows.note: Use this for severe suffering that someone has to endure, especially over a prolonged period.

example.english: Those few days of waiting for the surgery results were pure anguish.
example.traditional: 等手術結果嗰幾日，真係好煎熬。
example.jyutping: dang2 sau2 seot6 git3 gwo2 go2 gei2 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zin1 ngou4

rows.note: Use this for deep emotional pain, especially grief or pain caused by a loss or traumatic event.

example.english: The anguish in my heart after losing my best friend has never gone away.
example.traditional: 失去最好嘅朋友之後，心入面嘅傷痛一直未散。
example.jyutping: sat1 heoi3 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5 zi1 hau6 sam1 jap6 min6 ge3 soeng1 tung3 jat1 zik6 mei6 saan3
